verdict.rationale: Elicit's pricing page lists 'API access' as a feature (elicit-docs-6), suggesting some programmatic access exists, but there is no documentation of the API's capabilities, authentication, or usage for CI/automation, and probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. Missing for 10: documented API reference, CLI or SDK for headless use, CI/automation examples, and confirmation the API covers core workflows (search, screening, extraction) rather than just data export.
